description: NaCdAsS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-24°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.18 Å. Cd is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.58-3.17 Å. As is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There are a spread of As-S bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.31 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one As atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na, one Cd, and one As atom to form distorted SNa₃CdAs square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNaCd₄As octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃CdAs square pyramids, edges with three equivalent SNaCd₄As octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₃CdAs square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-83°. In the third S site, S is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Cd, and one As atom to form distorted SNaCd₄As octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SNaCd₄As octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃CdAs square pyramids, edges with four equivalent SNaCd₄As octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₃CdAs square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°.
